semiconductor_relevance: High — Everlight Chemical specializes in high-tech chemical products essential for semiconductor manufacturing, particularly in photoresist and ancillary materials.
summary: Everlight Chemical Industrial Corporation develops and manufactures a wide range of high-value chemical products for the semiconductor industry, focusing on photoresists and related materials. Their offerings include positive and negative photoresists, shielding photoresists, and various ancillary products that enhance the manufacturing process.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Everlight Chemical is publicly listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange and has a strong presence in the local semiconductor materials market.
